title: Caxaaxuwi aracak yewqeh yan num
intro: cuumi le gino inki adda fayyale caddot sugte ginok, mango mari edde yaabam duudak muxxi yallih xaynal. uxih kaxxiina ramid beyteeh, inki abto sadi manoh korsi milaagteh. away, ta gino xiibite naqboyti innal meekita, tutucto kee ekraaro xagni ayro guftam fan. Atu tama radde numih mamaxxaga duuddaa?
clues: Anu inki adda too xayih yan marih fanat suge, mango ginok dagah fayya iyya.
Anu cararoowuk hadlime, ardik akkek kallaytok hinna.
Qusba ginook foocal cultam amrisen wak, anu cineh — anu innih elle aamineh an innal gexsiise.
Anu irol qidim kee abaarot suge, takkay immay ellecaboh yimixxigeh, muggaaqime wakti fan udurruteh yomcowwe.
Anu xiqqa haamal mango mara hoxah xagana culeh, Adam samad kulli afkanal xayyoowak.
Anu fakut yan, inkih tan seehadayti baxi naqboyti kinniyo, umman way ekraaro kee tutuctoy muggaaqime gaba kalti fan.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
